analysis_packet.certificate: Authorize intervention only when online observations expose persistent decision-relevant ambiguity between competing causal explanations and a bounded probe can distinguish them without hidden-trace access, oracle adaptation, benchmark inspection, or unsupported commitments. Until that condition holds, retain observation-conditioned control; once satisfied, perform a minimal legal input-conditioned intervention, attribute its observed outcome, update control state, and return to ordinary online adaptation while preserving interface, capacity, uniqueness, and current-residency obligations.
exact_actions: Define an admissible trigger as persistent, decision-relevant causal ambiguity supported solely by online observations plus a bounded legal probe.
Remain in observation-conditioned control before the trigger; do not intervene on weak, speculative, or unsupported evidence.
At the trigger, select the smallest input-conditioned probe whose possible outcomes separate the live causal hypotheses without violating task constraints.
Record the probe context and outcome, attribute the resulting evidence only to that intervention, and update the controller state.
Resume observation-conditioned adaptation using the attributed evidence, retaining all exclusions and enforcing legality, residency, uniqueness, and capacity invariants.
obligations: Preserve all unsupported-commitment exclusions before and during construction.
Use only one-access-at-a-time visible evidence; never inspect traces, benchmark paths, or oracle decisions.
Keep the emitted policy interface legal and return only currently cached unique integer keys.
Never exceed capacity_bytes, including during intervention and state transition.
Emit one complete policy lineage with no branching, voting, retries, or score-based selection.
witnesses: The anchor is an online-only standard-library policy with adaptive recent/frequent and ghost evidence states.
The stated bottleneck is unresolved decision-relevant causation after passive observation.
The hypothesis requires an evidence-triggered transition from observation-conditioned control to intervention-attributed control.
Scores and evaluator-side reference information are unavailable and must remain unused.
